*[[Iraq–United States relations]], [[Iran–United States relations]]
**A rocket explodes inside the heavily fortified [[Green Zone]] sector of [[Iraq]]'s capital, landing less than a mile from the [[Embassy of the United States, Baghdad|U.S. Embassy in Baghdad]] amid heightened tensions in the region between the [[United States]] and [[Iran]]. [https://www.apnews.com/890156f1ffc1457ba97acd598753be94 (Associated Press)] [https://www.latimes.com/world/la-fg-iraq-rocket-near-us-embassy-20190519-story.html (''Los Angeles Times'')]

;Business and economy
*[[China–United States trade war]]
**[[Google]] pulls [[Android (operating system)|Android]] update support for [[Huawei]] phones, as well as the [[Google Play|Google Play Store]] and [[Gmail]] apps, after the [[China|Chinese]] technology company was blacklisted by the [[United States Department of Commerce|United States Commerce Department]]. [https://www.theguardian.com/technology/2019/may/19/google-huawei-trump-blacklist-report (''The Guardian'')]
*[[Martin Tower]], the tallest building in [[Bethlehem, Pennsylvania]], is destroyed in a controlled demolition by the [[Controlled Demolition, Inc.]] firm. The 21-story building, which was listed on [[National Register of Historic Places]], had been vacant since 2007. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/av/world-us-canada-48343359/martin-tower-former-bethlehem-steel-headquarters-demolished (BBC News)]

;International relations
*The [[White House]] is expected to announce the first part of their [[List of Middle East peace proposals|Middle East peace proposal]] in what officials are calling an economic "workshop" to encourage investing capital in the [[West Bank]], [[Gaza Strip|Gaza]], and the region. The workshop is expected to happen on June 25 and 26 in [[Manama]], [[Bahrain]]. [https://edition.cnn.com/2019/05/19/politics/white-house-middle-east-peace-proposal/index.html (CNN)]
*[[Iran–Saudi Arabia relations]]
**[[Saudi Arabia]]n [[Ministry of Foreign Affairs (Saudi Arabia)|Minister of Foreign Affairs]] [[Adel al-Jubeir]] says his country "seeks to avert war, ready to respond with force and determination" to a would-be attack by Iran. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2019/05/saudi-arabia-seeks-avert-war-ready-respond-force-190519055552084.html (Al Jazeera)]
